name: edgar_companies_by_sic
description:
Companies in one industry, by 4-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code, from SEC EDGAR.
Returns {sic_code, companies_count, companies: [{cik, name, sic, sicDescription, fiscalYearEnd}]}.
Inputs (* required): sic_code* (string, 4 digits, e.g. 7372 prepackaged software, 3674 semiconductors, 6022 state commercial banks), limit (integer 1-500, default 50).
Slow: it reads each listed company's submissions file in turn (one request per company, 110 ms apart) until limit matches are found, so small limits return sooner. To read one company's SIC, edgar_company_submissions or sec_get_company_info is quicker.
Example: {"sic_code": "7372", "limit": 10}
No API key needed (SEC data.sec.gov; 110 ms between requests).

sic_code.description: 4-digit SIC code (e.g., '7372' for prepackaged software, '6022' for state commercial banks, '3674' for semiconductors)

companies_count.description: Number of companies in this industry

companies.description: Companies in the specified SIC code

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: SIC codes classify companies by industry. Useful for peer analysis and sector research.
